scope.proved: All 49 story-layer content resources, representing 72 physical LZ77 payloads and all 72 exact descriptor pointer fields across 24 rows, relocate into the registered story-visual-layers image region.
scope.editable: Each layer may replace its 4bpp graphics and 32x32 tilemap together, including changing the graphics tile count from 1 through 192; the palette remains 16 colors, tile IDs remain the exact contiguous 0x140-based range and every descriptor alias may split safely, subject to the aggregate registered-region capacity.
scope.not_proved: A different BG3 tilemap geometry, more than 192 tiles, another palette bank, changes to linked tile-assets config descriptors, scroll/window/blend timing, final screen equivalence or physical cartridge behavior.
